signal-orange.$description: Signal Orange — Orange supporting accent for decorative details and low-frequency emphasis. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ink.$description: Ink — Primary text — body copy, headings, post titles, timestamps, author names; warm-shifted near-black instead of pure #000 for less aggressive reading

paper.$description: Paper — Page canvas, card surfaces, input fields, nav background — the dominant surface, occupying the vast majority of the interface

charcoal.$description: Charcoal — Secondary text and high-emphasis link hover state; deeper than Ink for code blocks and emphasis blocks

stone.$description: Stone — Supporting neutral for secondary UI, dividers, and muted labels. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

ash.$description: Ash — Hairline borders, button outlines, icon strokes, disabled control borders

mist.$description: Mist — Divider lines, subtle icon backgrounds, skeleton placeholder fills

cloud.$description: Cloud — Light supporting surface for subtle backgrounds and section separation. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate.$description: Slate — Dark mode surface accent or pressed button state — infrequently used but present in the token set

black.$description: Black — Icon strokes, image overlays, dark accent blocks in promo cards

system-ui.$description: Primary UI and body font — used for navigation labels, buttons, post body text, metadata, input fields, and all interface chrome. The compact 12-13px metadata and 15-19px body sizes create the dense newsroom feel. Weight 400 for body, 500 for nav items and button labels, 600 for emphasized post titles and section headers.

cahuenga.$description: Branded display serif for product-level headings (sidebar headings, sign-up card titles, hero text). The medium weight and tight line-height give it editorial presence without feeling heavy; this is the only font that signals 'this is Substack' beyond the orange color.

spectral.$description: Long-form post body serif — used inside reader views and feed post content for editorial readability. The slightly looser line-height (1.20) keeps reading paragraphs comfortable while maintaining the compact newsroom density.

jetbrains-mono.$description: Code blocks and inline code within posts — the slight negative tracking (-0.014em) tightens the monospace for better visual alignment with surrounding serif text.

apple-system-ui-serif.$description: -apple-system-ui-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
